title: HELLO WORLD COMPUTER
author: Han × 1001
facts: onchain — perceptron rule at question settlement
description: This perceptron lives inside one contract. The contract stores the weights, trains them, and answers questions. You send it a short text (up to 64 bytes). ask() returns a yes/no label and a confidence value. All weights started at zero. Anyone can post a yes/no question for a fee. Each settled question updates the weights inside the contract.

call.note: ask("hello world") — runs the model on the text and returns (label uint8, confidence int256)
